title: Compact Blended-Wing UAV
description: A compact blended-planform UAV study built around a central propulsion body, an integrated payload bay, and a low-profile delta outline. The supplied sheet targets a 1 kg payload, 120 km/h maximum speed, and up to 60 minutes of endurance.
